name: KiCad KRT Gloss
description: Apply the KRT-based final track gloss to selected or all routed nets.
description_full: Standalone final-gloss plugin using KiCad Routing Tools as a pinned library dependency. Selected PCB objects identify complete nets; an empty selection processes every routed net. The dgloss engine has no pcbnew dependency. User layers show cumulative before/after changes.
